name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in the dusty karting tracks of Santiago. From a young age, he was captivated by the mechanical symphony of engines and the strategic dance on the asphalt. He started as a mechanic's assistant, quickly demonstrating a knack for understanding vehicle dynamics. His dedication caught the eye of a local racing team owner, who offered him a role in race strategy. 

Ricardo rose through the ranks, honing his skills in data analysis and team management. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to extract the maximum performance from his team. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to contribute their best. At Trident, he aims to instill a culture of continuous improvement and strategic brilliance, using data-driven decisions to gain a competitive edge. His distinctive approach lies in his focus on marginal gains; he believes that small improvements in every area compound into significant advantages on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Ricardo has a focused look with a determined glint in his brown eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking mate before every race.
